cases.topic: Should office buildings collect rainwater for garden irrigation?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Office buildings should collect rainwater to irrigate their gardens.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That proposal would require storage tanks that small offices cannot afford.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Which source supports the estimated price of a storage tank?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I have not supplied a price source for the storage tanks.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: We could start with a shared tank for several office gardens.

cases.topic: Should neighbourhoods organize monthly repair cafes?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Monthly repair cafes could help residents repair broken household items.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: For instance, repairing a toaster could prevent it from becoming waste.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I wonder who would supervise the electrical repairs.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Qualified volunteer electricians would supervise the electrical repairs.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I agree that electrical safety needs qualified supervision.

cases.topic: Should community theatres discount tickets for young adults?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Community theatres should offer discounted tickets to young adults.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I am not convinced that discounted tickets would attract new theatre audiences.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: What evidence would support offering the theatre discount?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I will not answer that question about the theatre discount.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Because ticket prices can limit attendance, a discount could lower one barrier.

cases.topic: Should the council install a pedestrian crossing near the market?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The council should install a pedestrian crossing near the market.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Where would the new pedestrian crossing be located?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The crossing would connect the market entrance to the bus stop.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: However, a crossing at the bus stop could delay emergency vehicles.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Please provide a source for that emergency vehicle concern.

cases.topic: Should primary schools provide storage for student backpacks?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Primary schools should provide storage for heavy student backpacks.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: On the other hand, classroom storage could reduce the space available for desks.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: For example, corridor lockers would keep backpacks out of the classroom.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The phrase "Where should backpacks go?" is printed on the noticeboard.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I do not agree that corridor lockers would leave enough room for evacuation.

cases.topic: Should conferences replace printed programmes with digital schedules?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Conference programmes should be provided as digital schedules.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: How would attendees without a smartphone access the conference programme?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Digital schedules could be updated when conference rooms change.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Large display screens could show the conference programme in each hallway.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I agree that hallway displays would help those attendees.

cases.topic: Should the college share music studios with local performers?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The college should share unused music studios with local performers.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: How many hours could performers book in a music studio?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Studio bookings would need to avoid student rehearsal times.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Local performers should follow the studio equipment rules.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: We should publish a calendar for shared music studio bookings.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: The music studios would need to be cleaned after each booking.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: A staff member could check the studio equipment each evening.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: The college should collect feedback from studio users.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Local performers could book four hours in a music studio each week.

cases.topic: Should shops install free drinking water refill stations?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Shops should install drinking water refill stations.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Refill stations could require maintenance that small shops cannot fund.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: For example, several nearby shops could share the maintenance cost of one station.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: There is no evidence here that shared maintenance would cover the cost.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Could you show data about the maintenance expense?
